Full-time ICT Business Analyst position available with competitive salary. Work in a dynamic team in Altona North, VIC 3025. Apply today through 11 Recruitment!

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Full-Time ICT Business Analyst
•	$80,000 p.a. plus superannuation 
•	Work in a professional environment.

Position Overview:
HYDAC Pty Ltd - HYDAC is a global provider of hydraulics, filtration and fluid technology solutions serving industrial sectors worldwide.
As an ICT Business Analyst at HYDAC Pty Ltd, you will be responsible for analysing business requirements and improving the digital systems that support engineering, sales, inventory, service and operational workflows. This position requires strong analytical thinking, stakeholder engagement and the ability to translate operational needs into practical ICT solutions.

Responsibilities and Tasks:

•	Work with users across engineering, sales, supply chain, service, finance and administration to formulate and document business and ICT requirements.
•	Identify, investigate and analyse business processes, procedures and work practices supporting HYDAC's hydraulic, filtration and fluid technology operations.
•	Identify system inefficiencies, deficiencies and limitations, and recommend improved business practices, system functionality and workflow behaviour.
•	Apply project management methodologies, principles and techniques to develop plans and assist with the costing, resourcing and delivery of ICT improvement projects.
•	Develop functional specifications for system developers, technology vendors and integration partners.
•	Use data and process modelling techniques to prepare clear system specifications for enterprise applications, reporting tools and system integrations.
•	Take responsibility for deploying functional solutions, including preparing and implementing system test plans to ensure acceptable quality, integrity and performance.
•	Create user guides, process documentation and training materials, and deliver training to employees using new or updated systems.
•	Act as a central reference point for ICT projects, providing guidance and information to support system proposals, priorities and decision-making.
•	Facilitate stakeholder workshops and interviews, maintain requirements traceability, and manage changes to agreed business and system requirements.
•	Coordinate system upgrades, integrations and releases with internal teams and external providers, supporting user acceptance testing, rollout and issue resolution.
•	Monitor post-implementation outcomes, analyse system performance and user feedback, and recommend continuous improvements to digital workflows and reporting.

Qualifications and Skills:

•	Relevant qualification.
•	Minimum 1 year experience as an ICT Business Analyst
•	Strong business process analysis, requirements gathering and documentation skills
•	Experience with process mapping, data modelling and functional specification development
•	Ability to analyse and improve enterprise systems, integrations and reporting workflows
•	Strong stakeholder communication, workshop facilitation, problem-solving and project coordination skills

Salary: The role offers a remuneration package of $80,000 p.a plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

How to Apply: 11 Recruitment is your pathway to securing this exciting opportunity. We are looking forward to facilitating your application and potentially welcoming you to a company that values expertise. Apply now and let us help you take the next step in your career.

result.description:
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Web Administrator to join our team and take ownership of our web presence, infrastructure, and digital platforms. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining websites while delivering reliable web technology solutions that support the organisation's objectives. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure our web environments are secure, performant, and continuously optimised. The ideal candidate brings a strong technical foundation, a proactive mindset, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
## Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain websites and web applications, ensuring consistent functionality, visual integrity, and a positive user experience across all platforms
- Monitor and manage web server performance, uptime, and availability, responding promptly to incidents and implementing preventative measures to minimise disruption
- Administer and configure web hosting environments, domains, DNS settings, and SSL certificates to ensure secure and reliable operation
- Collaborate with content, marketing, and development teams to publish, update, and manage web content in accordance with brand guidelines and accessibility standards
- Implement and maintain web security protocols, including regular vulnerability assessments, software patching, and user access controls to safeguard digital assets
- Analyse web traffic data and performance metrics using analytics tools, providing actionable insights and recommendations to improve engagement and site effectiveness
- Manage and maintain content management systems (CMS), including configuration, plugin or module updates, and user permission management
- Develop and enforce web standards, coding best practices, and documentation to ensure consistency and maintainability across all web properties
- Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to websites, web applications, and integrations in a timely and effective manner
- Support the planning and execution of website migrations, upgrades, and redesign projects, coordinating with internal stakeholders and third-party vendors as required
- Conduct regular audits of website content, links, and functionality to identify and rectify errors, broken pages, or outdated information
- Provide technical guidance and support to internal users on web-related tools, platforms, and best practices
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Web Development, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience
- Proven experience in a web administration, web development, or similar technical role
- Proficiency in core web technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
- Hands-on experience administering web servers such as Apache or Nginx, and working within Linux or Windows server environments
- Solid understanding of DNS management, domain administration, SSL/TLS certificates, and web hosting infrastructure
- Experience managing content management systems such as WordPress, Drupal, or similar platforms
- Familiarity with web analytics tools such as Google Analytics or similar, with the ability to interpret data and report findings clearly
- Working knowledge of web security best practices, including vulnerability management and access control
- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues efficiently
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to liaise effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Highly organised with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver outcomes within agreed timeframes
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant industry certifications such as Google Analytics, AWS, Microsoft Azure, or CompTIA Security+
- Experience with version control systems such as Git and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or deployment workflows
- Knowledge of PHP, Python, or other server-side scripting languages
- Experience with SEO best practices and web accessibility standards such as WCAG 2.1
- Exposure to cloud-based hosting platforms including AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure
- Experience working within agile or collaborative project delivery environments
- Familiarity with web performance optimisation techniques, including caching strategies and content delivery networks (CDNs)
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and shared success
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including training, certifications, and attendance at industry events
- Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid options that support a healthy work-life balance
- Work on diverse and meaningful projects that have a genuine impact on the organisation's digital presence and growth
- Competitive remuneration package with additional benefits and a supportive, inclusive workplace culture
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

result.description: Asseti Operations Pty Ltd  The Software Engineer is responsible for the design, development, testing, implementation and maintenance of software applications, backend systems and websites. The role requires strong technical expertise, problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions that meet business objectives and user requirements.  The role involves researching, analysing and documenting system requirements, writing and maintaining code, testing and debugging applications, supporting software deployments, resolving technical issues and contributing to the ongoing improvement of software systems.   Benefits   Task & responsibilities   Research, analyse and document system and software requirements for various projects.  Analyse user and business requirements and translate them into technical specifications.  Design software architecture, system components, data structures and integration interfaces in accordance with functional and technical requirements.  Design, develop, modify, implement, test and maintain scalable software applications, backend systems, websites and related services in accordance with software engineering principles and business requirements.  Write clean, efficient, scalable and well-documented code to meet system requirements and technical specifications.  Test, debug and diagnose errors in application programming, ensuring adherence to established protocols and programming standards.  Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues to improve site reliability, system functionality and user experience.  Maintain and enhance existing software applications and systems.  Optimise website and application performance through efficient coding practices and database management.  Manage testing and automation of software deployments and support the release of backend systems and websites.  Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, maintainability and adherence to best practices.  Work closely with product managers, developers and operations teams to align software solutions with business requirements and resolve technical issues.  Provide input into new features and system enhancements based on user feedback.  Create and maintain technical documentation, including system designs, workflows, technical specifications and user guides. AI Talent, a pioneer in AI-powered solutions, is looking for a meticulous and experienced Software Tester to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for verifying the quality and performance of our AI applications by creating and executing test plans, identifying defects, and working closely with developers to ensure prompt resolution.

Collaborate with the development team and project stakeholders to understand software requirements and design comprehensive test plans and test cases for AI software applications.

Work closely with the development team, product owners, and other stakeholders to understand requirements, clarify issues, and provide timely feedback on the quality of AI software products.
Collaborate with the QA team to establish and maintain quality standards, best practices, and processes across AI software projects.
Stay up-to-date with the latest trends and advancements in software testing methodologies, AI technologies, and industry best practices.

Weldworks is hiring a Full-time Construction Project Manager role in West Ryde, NSW. Apply now to be part of our team.

Requirements for this role:

Flexible hours available
2–3 years of relevant work experience required for this role
WELDWORKS PTY LTD is looking for an experienced Construction Project Manager for our client’s construction projects, including residential homes, commercial buildings, civil works and public spaces in Sydney.
On a full-time basis, you will be responsible for planning, organising, directing, controlling and coordinating construction projects, as well as managing the physical, financial and human resources involved in the construction process.

Title: Construction Project Manager, Full-time position
Salary: A$ 90,000.00 to 98,000.00 plus super
Work Location: In person
We are looking for applicants who demonstrate the following:

Requirements
•	Bachelor’s degree or higher in Construction Project Management, Construction Management, Building Technology, Building Science, Civil Engineering or another highly relevant field. 
•	At least 2–3 years of relevant experience managing residential, commercial, industrial or civil construction projects. 
•	Demonstrated experience managing construction schedules, budgets, labour, materials, plant and equipment. 
•	Strong knowledge of construction methods, building legislation, Australian Standards, quality requirements and workplace health and safety procedures. 
•	Ability to read, assess and interpret architectural drawings, engineering plans, specifications and construction contracts. 
•	Experience coordinating architects, engineers, consultants, subcontractors, suppliers, tradespeople and relevant authorities. 
•	Strong understanding of tendering, procurement, contract administration and project cost control. 
•	Ability to identify project risks, delays and budget variations and implement appropriate corrective actions. 
•	Strong leadership, communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills. 
•	Excellent organisational, reporting and problem-solving abilities. 
•	Current Australian driver licence preferred. 
•	Relevant registration, licence or site accreditation may be required depending on the project and scope of work. 

Construction Project Manager Responsibilities
•	Plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate construction projects from commencement through to completion. 
•	Establish project plans, construction schedules, milestones, budgets and resource requirements. 
•	Interpret architectural drawings, engineering plans, technical specifications and contractual requirements. 
•	Determine appropriate construction methods, sequencing, labour requirements, materials, plant and equipment. 
•	Coordinate the procurement and delivery of construction materials, equipment and services. 
•	Consult with architects, engineers, building professionals, consultants, tradespeople and technical workers. 
•	Negotiate and communicate with building owners, property developers, clients, suppliers and subcontractors. 
•	Prepare, review and contribute to tenders, quotations, contract bids and project proposals. 
•	Implement coordinated work programs across construction sites. 
•	Monitor project progress, expenditure, quality, safety, risk and compliance against approved plans and budgets. 
•	Ensure construction activities comply with relevant building legislation, Australian Standards, contractual requirements and workplace health and safety procedures. 
•	Manage and monitor the performance, quality and progress of contractors and subcontractors. 
•	Arrange the submission of plans, permits and supporting documents to relevant authorities. 
•	Coordinate required inspections, approvals and project handover activities. 
•	Prepare progress reports, budget updates, risk assessments and project documentation. 
•	Identify potential delays, cost overruns, quality issues and construction risks and implement appropriate corrective actions. 
•	Lead and supervise site managers, project engineers, supervisors, forepersons, subcontractors and tradespeople as required. 
•	Maintain effective communication with clients and key stakeholders throughout the construction process. 
•	Ensure projects are completed safely, on time, within budget and in accordance with the required quality standards. 

These responsibilities reflect the official ANZSCO functions for Construction Project Managers, including management of construction 
schedules, procurement, contractors, budgets, compliance, inspections and project resources. 
If you would like to discuss the role further, please click APPLY and send through an up-to-date CV. We can schedule a time to discuss the position available and determine whether the role is suitable for your qualifications and experience.
Work Location: In person
